newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Stg seen holding support at 2.80 marks.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Stg seen holding support at 2.80 marks.

text.p: Sterling seems to have exhausted its upside momentum after powering to new peaks above 2.82 marks on Tuesday but is expected to consolidate just above the 2.80-mark area, said analysts.
"Sterling may attempt to move higher to test recent peaks, but in the short-term a move higher is not sustainable," said Ian Stannard, technical analyst at Chase Investment Bank.

Stannard said the pound was likely to attempt to stabilise just above 2.80 marks with the unit aiming south towards the 2.79-mark area if that support was breached. At 0730 GMT sterling/mark stood at 2.8072/82 vs 2.8193/03 in late Europe.
